description.text: The tenth expansion, released on 18 March 2016, with Mega Alakazam and Lugia BREAK on the wrapper. It continues the XY BREAK story: Blue Shock's town rich in nature and Red Flash's town of the near future, joined in Rage of the Broken Heavens, here became one world, the scheme of the Psychic King, Mega Alakazam. M Alakazam-EX has the first Ability that works when a Pokémon Mega Evolves, letting it place damage on several of the opponent's Pokémon, and Lugia BREAK is the first BREAK Evolution from a Basic Pokémon. Delphox BREAK, M Altaria-EX, Genesect-EX, Glaceon-EX and Umbreon-EX join them. Packs held five cards. The cards are numbered to 78, followed by full-art Super Rare Pokémon-EX and Team Rocket's Handiwork and an Ultra Rare gold Alakazam-EX. In English most of its cards came out in Fates Collide in May 2016.
